classes.actor: It belongs to the one player who acted (`@s`): the presser, the buyer, the credited killer, the player who died.
classes.declared: The creator states which of these applies, in a field of the surface; the engine's default is the one that leaves nobody out.
classes.each: Every player has their own, kept on that player (a score, a tag, an inventory, a screen). One member's does not change another's.
classes.first-come: One physical thing in the world. Whoever takes it has it, and the party shares it by hand.
classes.no-runtime: The unit shapes the built world, the build's proofs or the authoring record. Nothing it compiles to addresses a player at run time, so player count cannot change it. Counted and excluded.
classes.parameter: A value of the surface that holds it (an operator, a slot, a colour, a shape, a mark). It has no audience of its own; it is judged with its holder.
classes.party: One fact for the whole party, kept on the `#party` holder, a `dw.sys` holder or in the world. It happens once whoever acted, and every member reads the same value.
classes.present: It reaches the players present in the world, or in a declared box, on the tick it happens: a telling, a sound, a status effect, a blow.

QuestEffect::teleport.evidence: `emit::teleport`: a box is `tp @e[<box>,tag=!dw_fixture]`, one PackTest per teleport; the party numbers every member (`dw.tpp`) and puts member `k` on seat `k` (`tp @a[tag=!dw_cutscene,scores={dw.tpp=k}]`), a viewer's kept place rewritten, one solo two-member PackTest per party teleport.
QuestEffect::teleport.semantics: `from` states who moves. A box moves every body inside it, players and entities alike; a player outside it stays. The party moves every member present, wherever they stand, each onto a seat of their own; a member on a death screen, waiting out a respawn or still choosing a class is seated by the respawn or the class, and a member away on the tick it fires is not owed the move.
